excludedCandidates.name: Big Bird's Nest
excludedCandidates.reason: Pro Game Guides and Beebom mention Big Bird's Nest as a special source for Copper Earring, Furnace Core, Light Shard, and Dark Shard, but BloxInformer Materials does not list it. Excluded until an in-game pass or a stronger primary source verifies the source and drop pool.

items.name: Blueberry Bush
items.routeUse: Fast starter Magic ingredient for low-Magic potion attempts and early material quests.
items.respawnOrRepeatNote: Repeatable world pickup; exact respawn timer not listed in checked sources.
items.verificationNote: BloxInformer, Pro Game Guides, and Beebom all list Blueberry Bushes as the Blueberry source, with chests as a secondary source.

items.name: Mushroom Cluster
items.routeUse: Common starter ingredient with slightly more Magic Power than Blueberry.
items.respawnOrRepeatNote: Repeatable world pickup; Pro Game Guides notes clusters are found around the world, mostly near water.
items.verificationNote: BloxInformer, Pro Game Guides, and Beebom all list Mushroom Clusters as the Withered Mushroom source, with chests as a secondary source.

items.name: Bird Nest
items.routeUse: Highest Magic Power starter-node ingredient before enemy farming starts.
items.respawnOrRepeatNote: Repeatable world pickup; Pro Game Guides notes nests appear in higher places such as trees and cliffs.
items.verificationNote: BloxInformer, Pro Game Guides, and Beebom all list Bird Nests as the Seagull Egg source, with chests as a secondary source.

items.name: Fern Bush
items.routeUse: Starter New Mainland gathering material for Sea of Oblivion potion attempts.
items.respawnOrRepeatNote: Repeatable world pickup; exact respawn timer not listed in checked sources.
items.verificationNote: BloxInformer lists Fern as obtained from Fern Bush and chests. Local materials data aligns with that source.

items.name: Sulphur Lumps
items.routeUse: New Mainland node material with more Magic Power than the first-island starter pickups.
items.respawnOrRepeatNote: Repeatable world pickup; exact respawn timer not listed in checked sources.
items.verificationNote: BloxInformer lists Sulphur Lumps as obtained from Sulphur Lumps and chests. Local materials data treats this as a sulfur-node pickup.

items.name: Volcanic Rock
items.routeUse: New Mainland node material that reaches early enemy-drop Magic Power values without a fight.
items.respawnOrRepeatNote: Repeatable world pickup; exact respawn timer not listed in checked sources.
items.verificationNote: BloxInformer lists Volcanic Rock as obtained from Volcanic Rock and chests. Local materials data aligns with that source.

items.name: Chests
items.routeUse: Broad pickup loop for materials and shards when you want resources without fighting every enemy on the path.
items.respawnOrRepeatNote: GAMES.GG lists fixed chest spots with a one-hour respawn timer; exact per-chest reward tables are not clearly listed.
items.verificationNote: Included as a summary row only. The dedicated chests dataset owns exact locations, route order, and chest-specific caveats. Image uses an existing clean in-game chest screenshot without guide arrows or editorial overlays.

items.name: Enchanted Sword Ferns
items.routeUse: Repeatable Enchanted Stone farming for wand enchantment rolls.
items.respawnOrRepeatNote: GAMES.GG describes them as respawning sources but does not list an exact timer.
items.verificationNote: Supported by the current GAMES.GG enchantments guide. The same source calls them enemies with extra HP, so this row should not be presented as a safe gathering node. Image uses a direct in-game Enchanted Sword Fern screenshot with the source label visible.
